genes.name: HLA Class II DR Beta 1
genes.function: Antigen presentation to CD4+ T cells via MHC class II
genes.ss_evidence: HLA-DRB1*03:01 and DRB1*15:01 associated with SS (OR 2.5). Shared with SLE. DRB1*03:01-DQA1*05:01-DQB1*02:01 haplotype confers highest risk for anti-Ro/SSA positive disease.

genes.name: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription 4
genes.function: Mediates IL-12 and type I IFN signaling; promotes Th1 and Th17 differentiation
genes.ss_evidence: STAT4 rs7574865 strongly associated with SS (OR 1.5). Drives Th1 and Th17 differentiation in salivary gland infiltrates. Shared risk with SLE and RA.

genes.name: Interferon Regulatory Factor 5
genes.function: Transcription factor driving type I IFN and proinflammatory cytokine expression
genes.ss_evidence: IRF5 rs2004640 and CGGGG indel associated with SS (OR 1.5). Drives IFN-α production in salivary gland plasmacytoid dendritic cells. Shared risk across SLE, SS, RA, SSc.

genes.name: TNF Alpha Induced Protein 3 (A20)
genes.function: Ubiquitin-editing enzyme that negatively regulates NF-κB signaling
genes.ss_evidence: TNFAIP3 polymorphisms associated with SS (OR 1.4). Reduced A20 expression in salivary gland epithelium leads to uncontrolled NF-κB. Shared with SLE, RA, and psoriasis.

genes.name: B Lymphoid Tyrosine Kinase
genes.function: Src family kinase involved in B cell receptor signaling and tolerance
genes.ss_evidence: BLK rs13277113 associated with SS (OR 1.3). Reduced BLK expression impairs B cell tolerance checkpoints. Shared across SLE, SS, RA, and SSc.

genes.name: B Cell Scaffold Protein with Ankyrin Repeats 1
genes.function: Scaffold protein modulating BCR-induced calcium mobilization and signaling
genes.ss_evidence: BANK1 polymorphisms associated with SS (OR 1.3). Regulates BCR calcium responses; risk variants → B cell hyperresponsiveness. Shared across SLE, SS, and SSc.

genes.name: TNFAIP3 Interacting Protein 1 (ABIN-1)
genes.function: Negative regulator of NF-κB; binds A20 (TNFAIP3) to deubiquitinate RIP1 and NEMO downstream of TNF and TLR
genes.ss_evidence: TNIP1 polymorphisms associated with SS (OR 1.3). Cooperates with TNFAIP3 in restricting NF-κB activation. Shared risk factor across SLE, SS, and SSc.

genes.name: Interleukin-12 Subunit Alpha (p35)
genes.function: Subunit of IL-12 (with IL12B/p40) and IL-35 (with EBI3); drives Th1 differentiation and IFN-γ production
genes.ss_evidence: IL12A rs485497 associated with SS (OR 1.3). IL-12 drives Th1 responses in salivary glands. Shared genetic risk with SLE and primary biliary cholangitis.

genes.name: B Cell Activating Factor (TNFSF13B / BLyS)
genes.function: Major B cell survival and differentiation factor; binds TACI, BCMA, and BAFF-R on B cells
genes.ss_evidence: BAFF is markedly elevated in SS serum, saliva, and salivary glands. BAFF overexpression in transgenic mice causes SS-like disease with salivary gland destruction and lymphoma. BAFF levels correlate with anti-Ro/SSA titers and lymphoma risk.

genes.name: Protein Tyrosine Phosphatase N22 (LYP)
genes.function: Negative regulator of T cell receptor and B cell receptor signaling
genes.ss_evidence: PTPN22 R620W (rs2476601) associated with SS (OR 1.3). Gain-of-function variant alters TCR and BCR signaling thresholds. Shared across T1D, RA, SLE, and autoimmune thyroid disease.

genes.name: Fc Gamma Receptor IIA (CD32)
genes.function: Low-affinity IgG Fc receptor mediating immune complex clearance and phagocytosis
genes.ss_evidence: FCGR2A H131R polymorphism associated with SS (OR 1.2). Altered IgG binding affects immune complex clearance in salivary glands.

genes.name: ETS Proto-Oncogene 1 Transcription Factor
genes.function: Transcription factor regulating B and T cell differentiation; promotes terminal B cell differentiation and antibody secretion
genes.ss_evidence: ETS1 rs1128334 associated with SS (OR 1.3). ETS1 regulates plasma cell differentiation. Reduced ETS1 expression in SS may impair B cell differentiation control. Shared risk with SLE.

genes.name: IKAROS Family Zinc Finger 1 (IKAROS)
genes.function: Master transcriptional regulator of lymphocyte development; controls B and T cell lineage commitment and differentiation
genes.ss_evidence: IKZF1 polymorphisms associated with SS (OR 1.2). IKAROS is essential for B cell development. Altered IKZF1 may contribute to B cell dysregulation in SS.

genes.name: C-X-C Chemokine Receptor 5 (CD185)
genes.function: Chemokine receptor directing B cells and Tfh cells to lymphoid follicles via CXCL13
genes.ss_evidence: CXCR5+ Tfh cells and CXCL13 are highly enriched in SS salivary glands. CXCL13 levels correlate with germinal center formation, focus score, and lymphoma risk.

genes.name: TNF Superfamily Member 4 (OX40L / CD252)
genes.function: Costimulatory ligand on APCs; binds OX40 on activated T cells to enhance Tfh and Th2 responses
genes.ss_evidence: TNFSF4/OX40L polymorphisms associated with SS (OR 1.2). OX40-OX40L costimulation promotes Tfh responses driving B cell activation and autoantibody production in SS.

genes.name: Cholinergic Receptor Muscarinic 3 (M3R)
genes.function: G protein-coupled receptor mediating acetylcholine-induced glandular secretion (saliva, tears)
genes.ss_evidence: Anti-M3R autoantibodies found in ~50-90% of SS patients. M3R antibodies impair salivary and lacrimal gland secretion. May directly contribute to sicca symptoms.

genes.name: Tyrosine Kinase 2
genes.function: JAK family kinase mediating type I IFN, IL-12, and IL-23 signaling
genes.ss_evidence: TYK2 mediates type I IFN signaling. TYK2 inhibition being explored for SS.

genes.name: Toll-Like Receptor 7
genes.function: Endosomal sensor of single-stranded RNA; drives type I IFN production in plasmacytoid DCs
genes.ss_evidence: TLR7 is directly targeted by HCQ in SS. TLR7 sensing of Ro/SSA-RNA in pDCs drives IFN-α.

genes.name: Toll-Like Receptor 9
genes.function: Endosomal sensor of unmethylated CpG DNA; activates B cells and pDCs
genes.ss_evidence: TLR9 senses CpG DNA; HCQ inhibits TLR9 activation reducing autoantibody production.

genes.name: Myeloid Differentiation Primary Response 88
genes.function: Universal adaptor protein for TLR7, TLR9, and IL-1 receptor family signaling
genes.ss_evidence: Universal TLR adaptor driving IFN-α in salivary gland pDCs.

genes.name: IFN Alpha/Beta Receptor 1
genes.function: Receptor subunit for type I interferons (IFN-α/β)
genes.ss_evidence: Anifrolumab target. Mediates type I IFN signaling in SS salivary glands.

genes.name: Interferon Alpha 1
genes.function: Type I interferon; key cytokine produced by pDCs
genes.ss_evidence: IFN-α massively produced by pDCs in SS. Correlates with disease activity.

genes.name: Interleukin-6
genes.function: Pro-inflammatory cytokine driving Th17/Tfh differentiation and B cell activation
genes.ss_evidence: Elevated in SS serum/saliva. Promotes Th17/Tfh differentiation.

genes.name: CD40 Ligand
genes.function: Costimulatory molecule on T cells engaging CD40 on B cells; drives germinal center responses
genes.ss_evidence: CD40L overexpressed on SS T cells. Drives germinal center B cell responses.

genes.name: Forkhead Box P3
genes.function: Master transcription factor for regulatory T cell (Treg) development and function
genes.ss_evidence: Treg dysfunction documented in SS. Low-dose IL-2 therapy being explored.

genes.name: CD19 Molecule
genes.function: Pan-B-cell surface protein; co-receptor that enhances BCR signaling
genes.ss_evidence: Pan-B cell marker targeted by CAR-T. Being explored for severe SS.

genes.name: Activation-Induced Cytidine Deaminase
genes.function: Enzyme mediating somatic hypermutation and class switch recombination in B cells
genes.ss_evidence: AID highly expressed in SS GC B cells. Links to lymphoma risk.
